topic: Even though and the reference to Ch. 8, §14.1.3
claim: After [64iv], where even modifies the pro-form so: “For discussion of even though and even if, see Ch. 8, §14.1.3.”
evidence_summary: Ch. 8, §14.1.3 treats even if (p. 747). Even though is treated in §13.2, p. 736 ([8] He knew they were there even though he couldn’t see them), and §13.3, p. 737, which contrasts I’m going out, even if it rains with I’m going out, even though it’s going to rain.
finding: Low confidence. The reference is right for even if, but even though is treated in Ch. 8, §13, which the reference should add.
proposed_wording: For discussion of even though and even if, see Ch. 8, §§13.2–13.3 and 14.1.3.

evidence.passage: §7.3.2, p. 594. “For discussion of even though and even if, see Ch. 8, §14.1.3.”
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
